items.title: Bob Stewart interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 24, 2006
items.q: people like Richard Wright and Zora Neale Hurston and people like that, how they have an improvisational approach to their writing skills.

ctx.x: Where he’s doing comparison things between jazz and the improvisational approach of jazz and the improvisational approach of jazz writing and people like Richard Wright and Zora Neale Hurston and people like that, how they have an improvisational approach to their writing skills. And he does a lot of that. And he also presents jazz things, he has a whole jazz program through the course of the year and he’s asked me to perform for his Halloween party.
